# Q
-- base/examples/complete/main.tf --
locals {
  name = "ex-${basename(path.cwd)}"
}

module "this" {
  source = "../.."
  name   = local.name
}
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name = "${var.name}-queue"
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
